rounds.text: Godavari Drugs Ltd is currently positioned for a turnaround, evidenced by a meaningful expansion in operating margins, which have improved by 2 percentage points both on a trailing twelve-month basis and in the most recent September 2026 quarter [E30, E31]. This operational efficiency is supported by a sector-wide healthcare tailwind [E65, E66] and a notable increase in institutional confidence, as domestic institutions have grown their stake from 0.50% to 2.58% [E41]. Furthermore, the company is actively managing its capital structure, evidenced by a reduction in total borrowings [E38] and a significant investment in Capital Work in Progress, which grew by 19.3% [E39]. The stock remains attractively priced relative to its peers, trading at a price-to-book ratio of 1.7x compared to the sector benchmark of 2.92x [E7]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with a poor five-year sales growth record [E51], high debtor days [E54], and a significant discrepancy between reported profits and cash flow [E34, E36]. Despite these headwinds, the recent quarterly increase in promoter holding [E49] suggests that insiders are aligning with the company's improving margin profile [E59].
